I am an old man farming here near Dar es Salaam. This plot is small, only a bit over one hectare, and I grow mixed crops together so my family has different foods from the same land. I do not have much money for chemical fertilizer, and the shop prices keep going up, so I rely on manure from my animals and some compost. I will use the seeds I saved from last season like my father did, and my sons and wife will help me work the land.
